criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 4's coursed ashlar is genuinely made: the socket shows a lit bed, a back wall and a shadowed head. Frame 3's grain-to-zero across a sawn arris at constant median is a technique that could not be swapped for another. Frame 5's unlit bond at 91.8 against a deck median of 20.4 lands the value argument before a word is read. Against that, frames 6, 7, 8 and 9 are all a rectangular plate seated on granite under a two-part contact shadow, four of nine, and the bottom row of the contact sheet reads as one move repeated.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: All three round-one hard fails are gone and each was verified on the rendered pixels. But computed.json publishes official_records: 4 against a first comment saying three, computed.json and the storyboard still say 'the rescheduled hearing' over a claims file carrying no rescheduling, computed.json says no figure is derived over a frame that derives a twenty position course from two claim dates, and frame 7's hook states in the record's voice what c17's own quote attributes.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Frame 9 names the room, the hour and the date and promotes the ask to Fraunces rank. But frames 1 to 4 are four consecutive frames on one table row, the AI charge does not appear until frame 5, the cover carries no AI subject at all, and frames 6, 7 and 8 are three unconnected items with no line back to the committee.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn at frame 5 is real and the red plate closes. The front end stalls: frame 2 shows the canceled row, frame 3 says the row gives no subject, frame 4 says the hour and room did not move, all off c1 and c2. The premise repair deepened this by moving frame 3 from no reason to no subject, making three frames in a row about what one row does not carry.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: House rules hold across all nine frames and the caption: ordinals on every recomposed date, no dashes, no colons or semicolons, no first person, no opening And or But, hashtags present. 'One course. One block never laid.' is a line a person wrote. 'The scheduling ran anyway.' is the one place the voice reaches for a drama the record does not have.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: #6B3C39 is measurably off deck 1 and deck 8's shared #9A3B2A and the technique set is not last fortnight's. But the storyboard's own measurement records a deck median of 20.4 sitting between priors rather than in the unoccupied band it planned for, and the plate on granite gesture recurs four times inside this deck.
